hints.title: Precompute Column Frequencies
hints.text: Precalculate the frequency of each character at each column across all words in the dictionary.

hints.title: State Definition
hints.text: Let dp[i] represent the number of ways to form the prefix of target of length i.

hints.title: Column-by-Column Transition
hints.text: Iterate column by column and update dp[i] backwards by adding dp[i-1] times the frequency of target[i-1] at that column.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: L is length of each word
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching paths across words directly leads to exponential branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Column character frequencies condense thousands of words into O(L * 26) table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize column independence and implement backwards 1D DP update.
